description: Audit a smart contract on Base: critical/high/medium/low risk with named flags (proxy pattern, zero supply, bytecode size, uninitialized proxy, suspicious ERC-20 properties). Detects EIP-1967 proxy patterns and reads token properties (name, symbol, decimals, total supply, ownership status). Use for token contract audits, before trading or approving a token, and for rug-pull detection. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: contract-risk
